prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Control Preview Redesign: Redesigns the final intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting key desktop pet controls like summoning, hiding, and talking.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to move, summon, and interact with your new pet anytime right from your desktop menu.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "text": "Quick Controls Overview"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Tutorial Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding tutorial screen demonstrating desktop pet right-click shortcuts and controls before concluding setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_tutorial"], "new_desktop_tutorial": {"headline": "Desktop Shortcuts & Controls", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop to talk, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.", "layout": "checklist", "button_label": "Got It!"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Friend Selection: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building engagement before requiring authentication.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your New Friend", "body": "Sign in to keep your pet safely synced across all your desktop devices."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Creation Safeguard Verification Flow: Adds a preview verification sub-screen before photo processing to confirm pet customization options.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_preview_check", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_preview_check": {"headline": "Verify Pet Appearance", "body": "Review your pet sprite preview and settings before finalizing adoption.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Looks Great!"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Activity Progress Status: Displays active generation status bars and real-time progress indicators on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Building your custom pet graphics and desktop animations..."}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Companion Path Selection Tip: Adds an explanatory hint on the path selection screen clarifying that pet settings can be changed later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Select standard companion or custom creation. You can always change pets later in settings."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Safety & Cloud Pet Sync Callout: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in saves pet progress and prevents data loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup", "body": "Sign in to ensure your pet attributes, custom memories, and settings are never lost.", "button_label": "Backup & Continue"}}
7: [adoption, layout] Certificate Adoption Stage Layout: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to a stage layout for a more celebratory adoption moment.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Welcome your official desktop pet into its new home!"}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Completion Notification Switch: Enables desktop system notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "We will send a desktop popup as soon as your pet is ready to roam."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Welcome Story Onboarding Introduction Copy: Refreshes initial story copy to set clear expectations on quick setup timing and pet interactions.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring an interactive pet to your desktop in under two minutes.", "button_label": "Start Choice"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout and copy inside onboarding is fully allowed.
Adding a new tutorial screen after the home intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in to take place after pet selection is explicitly allowed.
Adding a new verification sub-screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding real-time progress indicators to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding an explanatory hint to the path selection screen maintains its required core job.
Updating sign-in copy within onboarding is permitted and does not violate any rules.
Redesigning the certificate screen layout while preserving its core function is allowed.
Adding notification prompts on the waiting screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Updating copy on the story onboarding screen is allowed.
